stretch.name: Stretch
stretch.tip: Stretch the image to fill the element

clip.name: Clip
clip.tip: Crop and stretch the image to fill the element

horizontal.name: Horizontal
horizontal.tip: Progress displayed from left to right

vertical.name: Vertical
vertical.tip: Progress displayed from bottom to top

round.name: Circular
round.tip: Progress displayed in clockwise or counterclockwise direction

uiProgressBar-centerX.label: Center X
uiProgressBar-centerX.tip: Center X of the circular progress bar

uiProgressBar-centerY.label: Center Y
uiProgressBar-centerY.tip: Center Y of the circular progress bar

uiProgressBar-startAngle.label: Start Angle
uiProgressBar-startAngle.tip: Starting angle of the circular progress bar, 0° = right, clockwise rotation

uiProgressBar-centralAngle.label: Central Angle
uiProgressBar-centralAngle.tip: Angle between the end and start angle of the circular progress bar, can be negative

uiProgressBar-step.label: Step
uiProgressBar-step.tip:
For horizontal or vertical progress bars: texture sampling width is an integer multiple of the step size
For circular progress bars: texture sampling angle is an integer multiple of the step size
Step = 0: means no trimming on the progress bar

uiProgressBar-progress.label: Progress
uiProgressBar-progress.tip: Initial progress of the progress bar (0 ~ 1)

uiProgressBar-blend.label: Blend
uiProgressBar-blend.tip: Select a formula to blend the color with the underlying color

uiProgressBar-colorMode.label: Color Mode
uiProgressBar-colorMode.tip: How to obtain the progress bar's color

texture.name: Texture Sampling
texture.tip: Use pixel color from the progress bar image

fixed.name: Fixed
fixed.tip: Replace pixel colors in the progress bar image with a specified color

uiProgressBar-color-0-box.label: Red
uiProgressBar-color-0-box.tip: Red component of the progress bar color

uiProgressBar-color-1-box.label: Green
uiProgressBar-color-1-box.tip: Green component of the progress bar color

uiProgressBar-color-2-box.label: Blue
uiProgressBar-color-2-box.tip: Blue component of the progress bar color

uiProgressBar-color-3-box.label: Alpha
uiProgressBar-color-3-box.tip: Opacity of the progress bar color
